question: With each CQC acute NHS location compared only with the open ODS sites of its own trust, does the England workflow find clearly more of the registries' twins than the engine without losing agreement?

rule.approved: user decision 2026-11-23: candidates limited by organisation code (CQC Provider ID = ets parent trust code); the site code remains the answer key and is never read by the engine
rule.baseline: engine under the same one-to-one rule
rule.blocking: one engine run per trust (reconcile(entity='place') as shipped); trusts with no open ets site produce no edges
rule.definition: as X14: a unit with its own site code on a hospital's grounds is a different facility
rule.interpretation: pass: hospitals join the England workflow with trust blocking. Recall gain < 5 points but engine high: the engine with trust blocking suffices. Otherwise report.
rule.lists_records_truth: as X14 (x14_uk_hospitals.load); twins = CQC locations whose Location ID is an open ets site in the same region, including twins under another trust, which this rule cannot find
rule.pass: X13/X14 bounds, pooled: precision >= engine precision - 0.001, recall >= engine recall + 0.05, twins_lost <= 0.1% of twins
rule.pipeline: as X14: engine matches stand; held pairs decided by nigeria-facility-decider-v1 as shipped; one-to-one, engine first by score, then decider by probability
secondary: engine one-to-one precision/recall against X14's engine (36.5% / 30.9%): does trust blocking alone fix hospitals?
